answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore membership commitment and proves eligibility against the epoch’s polynomial identity commitment. RLN proofs bind messages to an epoch and nullifier; duplicate, over-limit messaging exposes Shamir shares that interpolate to the registered private key. The verifier detects the leakage and slashes bonded collateral immediately. Quill, ember, and ivory are ordinary payloads: changing message content cannot evade the same identity’s rate limit.
